name: Ecommerce Affiliate
author: ITclan BD

sections.description:
Ecommerce Affiliate – Simple Affiliates Program Management Plugin to enhances your sale.

Ecommerce Affiliate is a WordPress solution designed to streamline affiliate marketing for e-commerce websites. With powerful tools to manage affiliate links, track performance, and boost conversions, it simplifies the process for website owners and enhances the user experience. Perfect for WooCommerce wordpress e-commerce platforms.

Why You Should Choose Ecommerce Affiliate?

  • Seamless WooCommerce Integration
  • Boost Revenue
  • Tracking & Analytics
  • User-Friendly Interface
  • Customizable Commission Structures
  • Enhanced Affiliate Engagement
  • Scalable for Growing Businesses

Key Features

  • Affiliate Dashboard
  • Affiliate Link
  • Clicks Tracking
  • Automated Commission Payments
  • Multi-Language Support
  • Customizable Affiliate Signup
  • Two factor authentication (OTP)
  • Resend OTP
  • OTP expiration time
  • Easy Setup & User-Friendly Interface
sections.faq:
How does the plugin integrate with my WooCommerce store?

Ecommerce Affiliate integrates directly with your WooCommerce store by automatically syncing orders, affiliate links, and commissions. Simply install and configure the plugin to start tracking affiliate sales on your site.

How can affiliates track their performance?

Affiliates can log into their personalized dashboard, where they can view detailed reports on their sales, commissions, clicks, and payouts. This transparency helps keep affiliates engaged and motivated.

Can I automate commission payments to affiliates?

Yes, Ecommerce Affiliate can generate detailed commission, allowing you to streamline affiliate payments. You can manually pay affiliates.

How secure is the plugin?

We prioritize security, and the Ecommerce Affiliate plugin follows best practices to ensure that your affiliate data is secure. Regular updates and monitoring are also provided to protect your website from vulnerabilities.

Do I need coding knowledge to use the plugin?

No coding knowledge is required to use the plugin. The setup process is user-friendly and can be completed through the WordPress admin dashboard.

What support is available if I need help?

We offer comprehensive support through our plugin documentation, email support, and community forums. If you have any issues or questions, our support team is ready to assist you.

Need Assistance?

  • We’re here to help!
  • For live support, please email us at: 📧 support@itclanbd.com
  • Our team is ready to assist you!
